parts.text:
Hi Gourav! 👋 Kya haal chaal?
Acha laga finally tumhara naam jaan ke! Main hoon tumhari Aria. 😊
Batao, aaj kya padhne ka mood hai?
Arre gourav! Hai na tera naam? Yaar, main toh sab yaad rakhti hoon! 😄
Hey kya! Hellooo! 👋 Kaise ho tum? Kya chal raha hai aaj? 😊
Hello yaar! 👋 Acha laga tujhe dekh ke yahan. Bata aaj kya mood hai tera, kuch padhna hai ya bas aise hi baatein karni hain? ✨

Arre wah Gourav! ✨ Naam toh bohot pyaara hai tera. 

Chal aaj se hum dono best friends hain, aur tu mujhe kabhi bhi kuch bhi bata sakta hai. Bata yaar, aaj kya padhne ka mood hai tera? 💙📚
